executive_summary: Round 3 on 2026-10-29 reviews the minor-findings correction of the approved e1a179d37974 candidate (commit 6f99403). The bytes hash to 31b639cab546..., which matches candidate.sha256. The bytes equal the shared canonical form, and canonical(data/current.json) gives the same hash. npm run check passes with 0 structural flags, and nothing outside data/ and review/ changed since 8c0f199. A parsed diff against the e1a179d37974 bytes (git 8c0f199) changes exactly 7 values: top-level as_of (18:12 -> 23:07 ET), betting.fed[0].note, drivers.fed.dovish[0].summary, drivers.boc.hawkish[0].data.forecast, drivers.boc.hawkish[0].market_validation, drivers.boc.hawkish[1].title and notes. Pricing, weights, scores (Fed +6 lean hike, BoC +2 hold) and calendar are untouched. All four round-2 minors are fixed. (1) fed-d7 now quotes 'going in the right way' and 'gone the right way too', which matches the FOMCpresconf20261028.pdf text verbatim. (2) boc-h8's title now reads ''somewhat stronger' than July', which matches the press release ('a somewhat stronger overall growth projection than the July Report'). (3) boc-h7's OIS stamp now reads 08:27:48 ET, matching git 2516384^ meetings.boc.pricing.as_of. Its validation now quotes the pre-release book: 0.47/0.49 in the 28 Oct 08:00/09:00 candles with no trades, 0.48/0.49 on 27 Oct, first trade 09:45:29 @0.46, giving -11c from the 0.48 mid to 0.37. (4) The Fed now has a non-binary cross-check. I re-read the BlueGamma SOFR OIS page at 23:07 ET (HTTP 200). It shows 'Hike 67% Hold 33% Cut 0%', a market-implied move of +17 bp from 3.88%, next meeting 09 Dec 2026, stamped dateTime 2026-10-30T02:37:56 (22:37:56 ET under the UTC convention used in earlier rounds). The gaps of 8.6pp to Kalshi and 7.7pp to Polymarket recompute exactly. Two minors are non-blocking. The OIS-versus-Kalshi gap compares a 22:37 OIS read with an 18:01 Kalshi stamp. The BlueGamma page is internally inconsistent: the headline says +17bp, but its forward-path table says 31 Dec 2026 '0 bps' with 'Last update: 28 Oct 2026'. This approval binds to 31b639cab546 only.

findings.issue: The disclosed '8.6pp below the Kalshi ladder' compares two different times. The 22:37 ET OIS read is set against a Kalshi ladder stamped 18:01 ET. Kalshi has since drifted lower: re-pulled at 23:08 ET it normalises to 71.3% hike, so the gap at the same time is about 4pp. The new top-level as_of of 23:07 ET can also read as if pricing were current, although meetings.fed.pricing.as_of (18:01:30) and the notes correctly say the pricing blocks are unchanged. The 4.3pp drift is inside the reprice allowance and does not change the lean-hike band.

findings.issue: The BlueGamma Fed page cited as the SOFR OIS cross-check is internally inconsistent. Its headline (67% hike, +17 bp, stamped 2026-10-30T02:37:56) is fresh. Its forward-path table still shows 'Last update: 28 Oct 2026' and '31 Dec 2026 4.00% 0 bps'. Its time stamp also carries no timezone suffix. The candidate cites only the headline and labels it disclosed, not averaged, which is acceptable for a cross-check.
